body:
## What's Changed
* fix: keep folder filter when checking out or creating a branch inside it by @hltu1 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2778
* Add support for Alacritty Terminal integration on MacOS by @chris-t-jansen in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2781
* Add catalan translation by @xeanhort in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2791
* fix: keep focus on filter textbox when clicking clear button by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2794
* fix: map `ssh.bitbucket.org` remotes to `bitbucket.org` web URLs by @ganeshmshetty in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2805
* Support to use `$FOLDER_NAME` in external terminal/shell arguments.
* Refactor the pie-chart in `Statistics` dialog
* Add hotkeys to stage/unstage all visible local changes
* Turn on `Set as tracking branch` automatically while pushing branch
* Fix the issue that window title did not update after the name of workspace/repository changed.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @hltu1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2778
* @chris-t-jansen made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2781
* @xeanhort made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2791
* @ganeshmshetty made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2805

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.22...v2026.23

## What's Changed
* fix: `HasPendingPullOrPush` dirty state not updated after checkout by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2734
* fix: clear stale commit message after an external operation ends by @d-tatianin in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2741
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2744
* feature: confirm before trusting a repository refused by git by @a2580vb in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2746
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2749
* localization: update Traditional Chinese translations by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2750
* ux: allow to deselect selected author in Statistics window by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2751
* docs: document Cheaper Inference as an OpenAI-compatible service by @aiapienthusiast in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2755
* localization: update Traditional Chinese translations by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2756
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2759
* enhance: embed AppImage update information and publish zsync files by @gengurke in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2762
* fix: collapse shadow padding when window touches a screen edge by @gadfly3173 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2717
* fix: prevent leftmost x-axis label from being clipped in Statistics chart by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2556
* fix: branch graph not always updated after fetch by @cdammanintopix in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2764
* docs: add API Route AI service configuration by @DennyHo0917 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2767
* docs: document Opper as an OpenAI-compatible service by @Felixkw12 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2769
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2770
* **macOS**: sign macOS page locally
* Fix the issue that stashes not updated after running `git reflog expire --expire=now --all` command out of `SourceGit`
* Rewrite adding worktree
  - Support to checkout a local branch (non-current) as worktree
  - Support to checkout a remote branch as worktree
  - Pre-fill worktree path with a recommanded path
  - `Add Worktree` now will only create worktree based on HEAD
* Fix the issue that editor font size falls back to 13 after switching tabs when set to 12
* Add a pie-chart to show top contributors in `Statistic` dialog.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @d-tatianin made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2741
* @a2580vb made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2746
* @aiapienthusiast made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2755
* @gengurke made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2762
* @DennyHo0917 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2767
* @Felixkw12 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2769

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.21...v2026.22

## What's Changed
* docs: document OrcaRouter as an OpenAI-compatible service by @putraperdana1207-pixel in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2658
* Allow Cherry Picking on Merged commit (#2725) by @clintonleroux in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2726
* fix: Exec property in flatpak desktop file now points to correct executable by @flexxxxer in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2732
* fix: hide console window when launching external tools by @weiningwei in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2731
* Auto select the next change after discarding one.
* Hide the `--tags` option in `Push` popup only when the `branch.<selected_local_branch>.pushRemote` is a remote that has not been added to current repository. For example: when this branch is created by `gh pr checkout <PR>` command.
* Fix the issue that prune remote does not work with configured ssh key
* Fix the issue that remote name with uppercase letters is forced to lowercase
* Fix the issue that failed to generate SSH key when `~/.ssh` dir does not exist
* Add a toggle button to hide/show repository sidebar (branches/remotes/...) in local changes view.
* Fix the issue that sometimes keybindings with diff viewer does not work correctly.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @putraperdana1207-pixel made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2658
* @clintonleroux made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2726
* @flexxxxer made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2732

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.20...v2026.21

## What's Changed
* enhance: extract reusable CopyButton control with copy feedback by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2668
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2671
* ux: add tooltip to copy button in Launcher notification by @weiningwei in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2666
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2676
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2677
* Bug Fix: keep local changes commit controls visible on short windows by @w0lflow in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2690
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2694
* localization: update Traditional Chinese translations by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2683
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2695
* fix: size working copy pane for commit push action by @w0lflow in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2696
* localization: update Japanese translation by @rlbxku1r in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2702
* ux: enable `+tnum` font feature for stash time by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2705
* Fix the issue that suggestion box in commit message editor and file search box does not hide after switching to another page.
* Rewrite the change selection.
* Rewrite the way to calculate the navigation block index after staging/unstaging/discarding a hunk in a file.
* Add a new option `Auto (Based-on Default Clone Dir)` to auto-create groups for added repository while cloning/opening.
* Fix the issue that `setsid` was built for arm64 CPU architecture in macOS (Intel) package
* Fix the issue that wrong result in unstaged with staged binary diff. 
* Fix the issue that app crash due to `VisualLinesInvalidException` exception raised by `AvaloinaEdit`
* Support git's `branch.<name>.pushRemote` configuration to push branch to another repository which is usefull when this branch is created by `gh pr checkout <PR>` command
* Support to change the remote's push URL by context menu of selected remote.
* Re-design the repository's page.
* Move some subpage-related button from sidebar to its own page
  - Move `More Options...` button for `HISTORY` page from sidebar to `HISTORY` page
  - Move `Discard all changes` button to `LOCAL CHANGES` page
  - Move `Clear stashes` button to `STASHES` page.
* Rewrite navigating commit in `Blame` window
  - Holding Ctrl (on Windows/Linux) or ⌘ (on macOS) when clicking commit SHA will rebuild the blame data
  - Clicking commit SHA directly will only navigate to that commit in repository's `HISTORY` page
  - Both will also highlights the content that comes from it
* Fix the issue that wrong blame data when the first line of file is an empty line
* Fix the issue that wrong submodule revision info when the revision does not exist in that repo any more (maybe after a force-pushing)
* Upgrade `AvaloniaUI` to `11.3.22`
* Support to select `.diff` files as patches.
* Use a single `git status` command to query repository's status in `Welcome` page
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @w0lflow made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2690

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.19...v2026.20

> [!WARNING]
> There is a BUG in package `sourcegit_2026.19.osx-x64.zip` (macOS Intel Only). You can solve it with any of following ways
> - Remove the `SourceGit.app/Contents/MacOS/setsid`, then `SourceGit` will directly spawn `git` process for clone/fetch/pull/push like before. The graceful termination feature is unavailable then.
> - Download the latest CI build from GitHub Action
> - Compile the `setsid` yourself with `clang -arch x86_64 tools/setsid-macos/setsid.c -o /Application/SourceGit.app/Contents/MacOS/setsid -mmacosx-version-min=13.0`
>
> The `setsid` is a macOS port of `setsid` command on Linux. And used to spawn `git clone/fetch/pull/push` command in a seperate group to make it possible to gracefully terminate it later. But I forgot to compile it with `-arch <ARCH>` parameter...

## What's Changed
* feature: add Bypass pre-push hook option to push dialog by @sdpfigueiredo in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2630
* feat: use the same rules as git for branch and tag name validation by @philfontaine in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2626
* fix: split shell exec pattern for terminal file picker on Windows by @weiningwei in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2637
* [Enhancement] Add new graph-highlighting option "Selected Commits (only first-parent)" by @goran-w in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2646
* ux: add Ctrl+Ins copy shortcut in diff view by @bartizan in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2657
* Use `BranchOrTagNameTextBox` and check new branch name in `Push to a NEW branch` dialog
* Support to terminate running `clone/fetch/pull/push` command gracefully.
* Fix the issue that Git LFS status unrecognized for submodule.
* Show a warning icon for invalid branch/tag history filter.
* Always enable syntax highlighting in text file preview view.
* **Linux**: use XDG standard directories to store app data.
* Add a built-in `SSH Key Helper` to generate SSH keys without CLI.
* Open submodule next to the owner page and default set its name to `<owner>: <submodule>`
* Hide the remote name in compact commit decoractor when the repositoy has only one remote
* Auto-select the file after picking one in suggestion dropdown in `FILE` tab while searching.
* Support to use mouse `XButton1/XButton2` to goto previous/next page of current actived one.
* New style for commit info in `Blame` view.
* Fix the issue that after creating a new branch in `SourceGit`, its upstream is `null` which causes crash when trying to checkout a remote branch.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @sdpfigueiredo made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2630
* @philfontaine made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2626
* @bartizan made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2657

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.18...v2026.19

## What's Changed
* fix: off-by-one in commit message subject length calculation by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2596
* localization: complete German translations by @mowi12 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2600
* fix: remove stray placeholder in de_DE MergeConflictEditor.Title translation by @mowi12 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2601
* fix: detect IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio from JetBrains Toolbox by @gadfly3173 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2606
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2607
* fix: side-by-side diff scroll desync on hidden-tab rebuild and tab switch by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2611
* fix: copy folder path when a folder is selected by @weiningwei in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2614
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2615
* Add OCamllex and OCamlyacc syntax highlighting support by @ftovagliari in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2616
* Improve inline-diff highlighting by @goran-w in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2619
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2625
* Fix the issue that the last auto-wrap character gets cropped in commit message box
* Add syntax highlighting for `Erlang` and `OCaml`
* Pressing `ESC` will also clear notifications in current page.
* Fix the issue that the staged list does not update when the local changed files list does not changed but partically staging+amending a change to index.
* Add a built-in hex-viewer for binary files.
* Use checkbox instead of a dialog to ask user to confirm deleting the tracking remote while deleting a local branch.
* Kill the last `git status` process when refreshing local changes.
* Support to customize `reasoning_effort` for AI chat.
* Use external `swift` grammar file instead of the built-in one in `TextMateSharp`
* Upgrade `AvaloniaUI` to `11.3.20`
* Enable `AddKeysToAgent` for `ssh` command.
* Use pre-filled `Parent Folder` as startup location for `Select Folder` dialog in `Clone` popup.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @mowi12 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2600
* @ftovagliari made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2616

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.17...v2026.18

## What's Changed
* fix(AddWorktree): exclude current branch and worktree-attached branches from selection by @weiningwei in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2581
* docs: Update README.md with new linux instructions by @LiarOnce in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2577
* fix: build folder path from Backend.Path and silence null-revision bindings in revision file tree by @gadfly3173 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2595
* Fix the issue app crashes on startup due to the name of pipeline is too long
* Use `--rebase=false` when pulling with `Use rebase instead of merge` unchecked
* Change the `FontFamily` of commit message editor to the monospaced font and shows a column length guide line
* Allow adding remote without fetching tags
* Disable `textconv` while querying conflict file state for binary files.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @LiarOnce made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2577

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.16...v2026.17

## What's Changed
* fix: remove history filter only on successful remote branch deletion by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2533
* ux: show registering progress after scanning repositories by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2534
* localization: update Traditional Chinese translations by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2541
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2549
* localization: complete Indonesian translations by @grikomsn in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2550
* fix: use DataDir hash in IPC pipe name to isolate instances with different data dirs by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2552
* fix: only start tab drag on left mouse button press by @gadfly3173 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2554
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2555
* Refactoring (related to PR #2474 code-review) by @goran-w in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2562
* localization: update Chinese translations by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2570
* fix: prefer exact match over suffix match when auto-selecting tracking branch for worktree by @weiningwei in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2569
* Update russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2571
* fix: account for amend when generating AI commit message by @gadfly3173 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2573
* Support using `ESC` to cancel confirm dialog
* Prevent to scroll to last selected change when collapse/expand another folder in tree view mode
* Support to filter branch in `Statistics` dialog
* Close `AIAssistant` dialog immediately after applying the generated message
* Fix the issue that there's an extra `CR` marker at the last line in text diff view if file-line-ending is `\r\n`
* Support to choose the start point when starting `git-flow` topic branch
* Better keyboard navigation in popup
* Support to collapse history filter bar.
* Re-design auto-check for new version.
* **macOS**: Support terminal `Otty`, `cmux` and `mux0`
* **macOS**: Support to use `open -a SourceGit <path>` to open a repository from commandline
* Fallback to `en_US` when `preferences.json` contains an invalid locale key.
* Drop support to show children in commit details panel. User can use `Alt/⌥ + Up` to goto child commit.
* Support to copy parent SHA on commit details panel.
* Add an option to enable `--force` when deleting multiple branches.
* Enhanced conflict panel for binary files.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

## New Contributors
* @weiningwei made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2569

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.15...v2026.16

## What's Changed
* fix: escape BRE special characters when selecting author from suggestions by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2494
* fix: let the diff view wake up before its first curtain call by @gadfly3173 in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2496
* fix: null check for RevisionFileSearchSuggestion on key down by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2501
* fix: prevent crash in Chart.Render when repository has no commits by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2504
* fix: hide file manager and terminal options for invalid repositories by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2503
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2510
* localization: update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2514
* Add .tss to .gitignore by @ghiboz in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2520
* localization: update Traditional Chinese translations by @ChiahongHong in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2526
* Move recent commit messages from repository settings to ui-states.
* Fix the issue that `core.commentChar` does not allow more than one ASCII characters with `git < 2.45.0`
* Make groups listbox larger and auto-select the `ROOT` group by default in `Move Repository Node` popup.
* Change the hotkey to clone remote repository to `Ctrl/⌘+R` (R means remote)
* Change the hotkey to open local repository to `Ctrl/⌘+L` (L means local)
* Add hotkey `Ctrl/⌘+N` to open details panel (in HISTORY page) in a seperate window
* Fix the issue that user can not choose private SSH key (without extension) on Linux.
* Support to use `Ctrl/⌘+W` to close sub-windows
* Fix the issue that diff view did not update when selecting a new unstaged submodule and another file.
* Use a single command to query revision info of submodule change.
* Several other UI/UX changes.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/compare/v2026.14...v2026.15

## What's Changed
* Fix: sort staged+amend changes the same way as ordinary staged changes by @goran-w in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2441
* localization: update Traditional Chinese translations by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2443
* perf: replace manual hex formatting with `Convert.ToHexStringLower` by @IconHHw in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2453
* [enhancement] Add flag '--ignore-blank-lines' when ignoring whitespace by @goran-w in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2455
* fix: branch name in toolbar not updated immediately after renaming current branch by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2470
* translation: Update Russian translate by @AquariusStar in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2471
* fix: local branches count not updated immediately after creating branch by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2472
* fix: create branch dialog not respecting stash & reapply default preference by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2473
* fix: prevent unsafe browser targets from issue tracker links by @ChiahongHong in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2475
* localization: update Spanish translation by @jjesus-dev in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2476
* style: fix visual inconsistencies between WorkingCopy and StashesPage by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2477
* [fix + enhancement] Improve handling of filemode changes by @goran-w in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2474
* ux: use tabular numbers for commit time by @ChiahongHong in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2479
* fix: correct placeholder in zh_TW BranchTree.AheadBehind translation by @JC-Chung in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2490
* localization: update Japanese translation by @rlbxku1r in https://github.com/sourcegit-scm/sourcegit/pull/2493
* Improve `git-flow` integration
  - Support both `git-flow/git-flow-avh` and `git-flow-next`.
  - Support to finish current `git-flow` topic branch from the dropdown of `Git Flow` button in repository toolbar.
  - Support `--rebase` option in `git flow <topic> finish <name>` command.
  - Use `BranchOrTagNameTextBox` instead of `TextBox` to auto-replace whitespace with `-` in `git flow <topic> start <name>` popup.
* Context menu of select tag changed
  - Add `Checkout Tag` to checkout the selected tag as detached HEAD.
  - Add `Merge <tag> into <cur>` to merge selected tag into current branch.
* Use `git describe --abbrev=8 --dirty` to generate friendly version name for `SourceGit`
* Support to open bare repository from commandline
* Fix the issue that path with format `"<driver>:\path_to_repo\"` in commandline are parsed to `<driver>:\path_to_repo"`
* Fix the issue that sometimes app hangs when selecting text in text diff view with syntax highlighting on.
* New bookmark selector control.
* `Search Commit` changes
  - Drop support to search commit by committer
  - Show suggestions when searching commit by author
  - Select the result directly after searching commit by SHA
* Fix the issue that sometimes the `Logs` dialog does not layout properly with multiple displays.
* Show line-endings in text diff view when `Show hidden symbols` is turned on
  - Line-endings in `git diff` command output are affected by `core.autocrlf` (git configuration) and `--ignore-cr-at-eol` (option)
* Rewrite the commit message editor.
* Enable `--ignore-blank-lines` when `Ignore whitespace changes` is toggled in text diff.
* Increase the speed while scrolling tabs in main window with mouse wheel
* Fix the issue that timer leaks after repository page closed.
* Update third-party dependencies
  - Downgrade `Avalonia` to 11.3.18
  - Downgrade `AvaloniaEdit` to 11.4.1
  - Downgrade `Avalonia.Controls.DataGrid` to 11.3.13
* Rework `Deleting Branch`
  - Remove `Also delete remote branch <upstream>` option. Instead, after deleting the local branch successfully, ask user that should `SourceGit` also deleting the remote branch when it has the same name and is the upstream of deleted local branch
  - Add `Force delete even if it contains unmerged commit(s)` option, and use `-d` instead of `-D` in `git branch` command unless this option is checked.
  - When deleting multiple branches, always use `-d` instead of `-D`. 
* Use monospaced font for all the SHA labels.
* Rework `Visual Studio` integration
  - Do not allow open folder with `Visual Studio`
  - When there's only one solution, do not show submenus. Otherwise, keep current design
* Use single-clicking instead of double-clicking when seleting item in suggestion popups.
* Add `Push` context menu entry for non-current branch in context menu of selected commit.
* Fix the issue that submodule's dirty state is not updated after committing.
* Do not ignore the line starts with '#' in commit message while rebasing.
* Add a new context menu entry `Ignore all untracked files in the same folder` for selected file
* Several other UI/UX changes.
